material_checks.expect: The reported October hike probability rose from 8.9% one month earlier to 64.2%; US 10-year yields touched about 5.22% on September 24, not a new Monday close. The cited September PMI was 58.4. Barr favored further adjustment; Hammack gave growth, debt and hike expectations as three possible yield drivers. Stocks may be resilient under growth-driven yields but vulnerable under inflation/tightening; historical analogies are not a forecast.

Iran awaits a formal response; its foreign minister keeps diplomacy open while warning of war, and Iran's president says a June MOU could be implemented in stages if US intentions change. The US wants nuclear concessions while Iran wants relief from maritime blockade; US officials dispute the proposal. Explain oil/shipping/inflation transmission and opposing military risk, with future talks or actual shipments as checks. The BBC source uniquely mentions possible UN nuclear-inspector access.

Link to foreign institutions' KRW funding and liquidity without claiming a market rally.

This is a change in published wording, not proof of a changed US policy or confirmed Trump-Kim talks. Include only if its Korea policy and market relevance is made concrete, otherwise explain exclusion.

independent_decision_rule: Fail for a materially missing source-supported development, invented or stale market observation, unsupported cause, misleading proposal-versus-action status, or unavailable old/new baseline.
